final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.avg_bandwidth_usage AS difference_above_overall FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.avg_bandwidth_usage ORDER BY difference_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10
